name: Starlink Group 10-49
slot_a_text: SpaceX's 103rd launch of the year, 722nd all time. 46th from SLC-40 this year, 3 days after the last one. The 203rd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 328 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
description: A batch of 29 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
